selection_basis: Independent September 2026 blind-listener benchmarks place Cartesia Sonic 3.6 at or near the top for perceived TTS quality; Eleven v3 remains the cinematic multi-speaker/dialogue specialist.

fallback.rule: No legacy or zero-credit voice fallback is allowed. Dialogue-bearing production must use an approved premium provider and pass voice QA, otherwise the build fails closed.

acceptance: speaker voice IDs stay locked by character
no SFX or production directions appear in spoken text
best QA-scored premium take wins when multiple providers are available
routing: If Cartesia Sonic 3.6 is configured: generate and use Cartesia as the production default.
If ElevenLabs v3 is also configured: it may be generated as an optional comparison candidate, but Cartesia remains the required primary provider.
If Cartesia is unavailable or fails QA: fail the dialogue-bearing build. Do not use legacy AI Voice Generator output, pinned preview audio, or zero-credit local voice assets.
